install.notes: setup.py:5 declares only gym>=0.12.1. Running the upstream environment also needs numpy and matplotlib (ur5_env.py:2-4), CoppeliaSim with the UR5-Gripper-thread-pyapi.ttt scene (README.md:10) and the PyCopp remoteApi shared library; the clone vendors only remoteApi.dll (pycopp/sim.py:11-21). None of that is installed or imported by the gate: the fake backend is pure Python.
